description: Enumerated from the player's own request and judged by the pinned engine (ADR-006, `choices.ts`, `choice-judge.ts`). The golden choice corpus covers preview, every target type in the format's move pool, Mega, forced switches, conflicting switches, visible and hidden trapping, Imprison (`maybeDisabled`/`maybeLocked`), a fainted active with no replacement and a locked move; a brute-force oracle finds no engine-accepted action outside the enumerated set. Unverified: no in-game fixture yet.
